usageNotes: Use this to relocate a VM disk to a different storage pool (e.g., migrating from local-lvm to a Ceph or NFS datastore) or to reassign a disk to a different VM on the same node. Returns a task UPID — poll the tasks API to track completion, as the copy operation runs asynchronously and duration scales with disk size. Without 'delete: true', the source disk is retained as an unused slot on the original VM, which will consume storage until manually removed.

examples.summary: Move VM 101 boot disk from local-lvm to a Ceph pool, deleting the original after copy

tips: The VM does not need to be stopped for this operation — live disk moves are supported, but the VM must remain on the same node; cross-node moves require a full migration instead.
Omitting 'format' preserves the source disk format; specify 'raw' when moving to Ceph/RBD since those pools do not support qcow2.

When moving a disk to another VM ('target-vmid'), supply 'target-disk' if you need it mapped to a specific controller slot; otherwise it inherits the source key, which may conflict if that slot is occupied on the target VM.
Use 'digest' and 'target-digest' to guard against concurrent config changes — read the VM config first to obtain the current digest value.
Use 'bwlimit' to cap I/O during production hours and avoid saturating storage network bandwidth.
